applicability.description: Normalize a shipment record to canonical JSON {shipment_id, origin, destination, weight_kg, items[{sku, qty}]}. Supports source formats where the shipment is identified by an id field, has origin/destination fields (possibly nested under a route object, possibly named from/to or src/dst), carries a positive weight in kilograms under a name containing 'kg' (e.g., weight_kg, mass_kg), and lists line items each with an SKU-like code and a quantity.
claims: Maps scalar fields via dot-notation paths in the records dict
Coerces weight_kg to float and enforces strictly greater than zero
Builds the items list from a JSON-encoded array stored at a map-configurable key, with per-entry sku and qty sub-key remapping
Emits canonical JSON in fixed key order: shipment_id, origin, destination, weight_kg, items (each item as {sku, qty} in that order)
